title: The Bond Market Just Looked at America and Said, “Nah”
dek: Global yields are exploding, AI is running on borrowed money, and the president who demanded lower rates may have just hired the guy who raises them.
note: Every government bond market on Earth is lurching at once, and the years these yields last touched were each the year before something blew up. I lay out who lit the match: forty trillion dollars of debt, tariffs, and a shooting war that has oil climbing, all of it inflationary.

Then comes the punch line. Trump picked Kevin Warsh to cut rates, and Warsh walked into Jackson Hole talking like a man about to raise them. Meanwhile the AI boom holding the economy up is borrowing against buildings that don’t exist yet. I lived through 2000 and 2008. The bond market isn’t panicking. It’s doing math. The panicking is our job.

image.alt: Donald Trump holds a lit match before burning dollar bills and Treasury bonds, beside “WE DIDN’T START THE FIRE.”
